title.narrative: 223178_DEC Collective Initiative - Child Protection and Safeguarding for children and adolescents from Moldova and Ukraine

description.narrative:
The collective initiative funded by DEC and led by Plan international with cooperation with WV and local NGO CRIC.
The proposed project will commence on 1 August 2024, with an end date of 28 February 2025. The project aims to enhance the inclusion and safety of refugee and local children from Ukraine in Moldovan schools amidst the Ukrainian crisis. Key objectives include equipping educators, school staff, and NGOs with safeguarding knowledge, updating Child Protection policies, and fostering collaboration between schools, service providers, and local authorities. The Ministry of Education and Research (MER) will use feedback to update national guidelines and train educational professionals. Additionally, the 2014 MER regulation on media communication will be updated to ensure children's rights and safety. Plan International Moldova, World Vision, and CRIC will collaborate to improve safeguarding practices, promote local partnerships, and share expertise to enhance project outcomes.
Output 1: Teachers, school staff and NGO staff have capacity to develop Child Protection and Safeguarding policies, codes of conduct and mechanisms and produce recommendations for improvement to be shared with relevant stakeholders.
Implementing partners: World Vision (Activity 1.1), Plan International and CRIC (Activities 1.2 to 1.6)
Activity 1.1 Conduct one comparative review of child protection and safeguarding policies in Moldova and at least 3 countries of similar context
Activity 1.2 Conduct training sessions with teachers and school staff on the development of child protection and safeguarding policies, mechanisms and practices in schools
Activity 1.3 Capacity building of school psychologists to apply the methodology on prevention of and response to bullying
Activity 1.4 Workshops on Child Protection, Safeguarding policies, mechanisms and practices in school settings
Activity 1.5 Conduct training sessions on the development of Child Friendly Code of Conduct and Child Friendly Feedback Mechanisms in schools
Activity 1.6 Draft recommendations section on developing Child Friendly Code of Conducts in schools in consultations with children and adolescents
Output 2: Key stakeholders (teachers, school staff and NGO staff) have improved skills on how to engage with media in respecting the rights and safety of children and adolescents.
Implementing partners: World Vision (Activities 2.1 to 2.4) and CRIC (Activities 2.5 to 2.7)
Activity 2.1 Conduct two training workshops for 40 NGOs staff and media representatives, especially those covering children and refugee-related issues, on child sensitive engagement with media
Activity 2.2 Organize two dialogue - events between school faculty and media on the importance of protecting the rights of children and their responsibilities in that regard.
Activity 2.3 Build the capacity of 50 participants on communication and advocacy skills for targeted NGOs
Activity 2.4 Support local NGOs in advocating for the endorsement of the child protection and safeguarding policies/code of conduct to the Government of Moldova
Activity 2.5 Conduct Media Communication session with teachers and school staff
Activity 2.6 Facilitate the communication between MER and educational community
Activity 2.7 Draft recommendations section on engaging with media in respecting the rights and safety of children
